title: Diameter Intersections
approach: With an odd diameter the tree's center is an EDGE that every diameter contains, so a diameter is (depth-m path from c1) + edge + (depth-m path from c2) and every intersection is x+1+y over branch depths on each side; the answer is the sumset of the two branch-depth sets.

techniques.label: tree-center
techniques.why: the center is an edge here, which is the whole observation
